description_en: Assigns a role to a member in a workspace to grant the permissions associated with the role
description_zh: 为工作空间内的成员添加某个角色，使其拥有角色的权限
name: AddMemberRole

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The member ID. For information about how to obtain the member ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449135.html
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.help_en:
The role to be added. Both built-in and custom roles are supported:

Built-in roles: The following built-in roles are supported. For the permissions of each role, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html.
PAI.AlgoDeveloper: Algorithm developer.
PAI.AlgoOperator: Algorithm O&M.
PAI.LabelManager: Labeling administrator.
PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper: MaxCompute developer.
PAI.WorkspaceAdmin: Administrator.
PAI.WorkspaceGuest: Guest.
PAI.WorkspaceOwner: Owner.

Custom roles: Enter the role ID. The ID must start with role-, such as role-sw******2tij
parameters.help_zh:
要添加的角色，支持官方角色与自定义角色：

官方角色：如下所示，各角色权限请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2840449.html 。
PAI.AlgoDeveloper：算法开发。
PAI.AlgoOperator：算法运维。
PAI.LabelManager：标注管理员。
PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper：MaxCompute开发。
PAI.WorkspaceAdmin：管理员。
PAI.WorkspaceGuest：访客。
PAI.WorkspaceOwner：负责人。

自定义角色：填写角色ID。格式为role-开头，例如role-sw******2tij
parameters.name: role_name
